<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT } from '../../api/config'
import { fileSearchTimeoutMs, type FileSearchTimeoutMs } from '../../api/file-search-params'
import type { NormalizedDictionary } from '../../api/dictionaries'
import { choicesFromDictionary, FILING_PICKER_FIELDS } from '../../api/dictionaries/picker-catalog'
import { FILING_OPTION_KEYS, FILING_SELECTS, FILING_BLOCKS, filingCellKeys, filingDateDefaults, filingDraftFields, filingFieldLabel, type FilingCell } from '../../api/filing-form'
import type { FilingSearchQuery } from '../../api/filing-search-params'
import type { FilingSearchResult, FilingSearchRow } from '../../api/filing-search-types'
import { readFilingTimeout, writeFilingTimeout } from '../../api/query-timeout'
import { filingTemplateValues, filingTemplatesOf, applyFilingBuiltin, FILING_BUILTIN_TEMPLATES, FILING_TEMPLATE_TYPE, type FilingBuiltinTemplate } from '../../query/filing-templates'
import type { QueryTemplate } from '../../query/query-types'
import { hasOptionTree } from '../../query/option-tree'
import { activateOptionFallback, hasSavedChoices, hydrateOptionFallback, optionFallbackEpoch, rememberChoices, rememberDictionaries, rememberFormFields, savedChoices, subscribeOptionFallback } from '../../query/option-fallback'
import { describeOptionPull } from '../../query/option-pull-notes'
import { fitColumnWidths, type ColumnFit } from '../../shell/column-fit'
import { createTextRuler } from '../../shell/text-width'
import { isMultiPickerKey } from '../../shared/picker-modes'
import { scopeFromConnection, type ExpectedAccountScope } from '../../shared/connection'
import { MessageType, type FileSearchFormField, type MessageBridge } from '../../shared/message'
import { confirmDialog } from '../dialog'
import { useWorkspace } from '../composables/useWorkspace'
import { paintTaskCheckProgress, taskCheckProgress } from '../check-progress'
import { runFilingPages, type FilingPageResult } from '../filing-pages'
import ThemeSelect from '../../shell/components/ThemeSelect.vue'
import TreeOptionSelect from '../../shell/components/TreeOptionSelect.vue'
import WDatePicker from '../../shell/components/WDatePicker.vue'

const props = defineProps<{ bridge?: MessageBridge; userId: string; canSearch: boolean; manage?: boolean }>()
const emit = defineEmits<{
  searched: [query: FilingSearchQuery]
  export: [rows: FilingSearchRow[]]
}>()

/** 通道优先用外层传进来的，缺了再用注入的。两处都没有时查询要报错，不能一声不吭不响应。 */
const injectedBridge = inject<MessageBridge>('bridge')

function activeBridge(): MessageBridge | undefined {
  return props.bridge ?? injectedBridge
}

/** 打开页面时结束日先填今天，想查别的区间自己改或清掉。 */
const values = ref<Record<string, string>>({ ...filingDateDefaults() })

/**
 * 递交查询模板只存本机：原站的递交列表没有模板功能，保存和删除都不写原网站。
 * 模板走和文件查询同一套本地配置包（saveQueryTemplate / deleteQueryTemplate），只是 queryType 记 FilingSearch。
 */
const workspace = useWorkspace()
const templates = ref<QueryTemplate[]>([])
const selectedTemplateId = ref('')
const saveName = ref('')
const saveNameDirty = ref(false)
const templateMessage = ref('')
const savingTemplate = ref(false)
const deletingTemplate = ref(false)

const selectedTemplate = computed(() => templates.value.find(item => item.id === selectedTemplateId.value) ?? null)
/** 内置模板排在前面：随扩展带来，谁登录都能点，不能改也不能删。 */
const selectedBuiltin = computed(() => FILING_BUILTIN_TEMPLATES.find(item => item.id === selectedTemplateId.value) ?? null)
const templateCards = computed(() => [
  ...FILING_BUILTIN_TEMPLATES.map(item => ({ id: item.id, name: item.name, builtin: true })),
  ...templates.value.map(item => ({ id: item.id, name: item.name, builtin: false }))
])

function liveScope(): ExpectedAccountScope | null {
  const scope = scopeFromConnection(workspace.connection.value)
  if (!scope || scope.operatorId !== props.userId) {
    templateMessage.value = '当前页面账号与已绑定会话不一致，未保存。'
    return null
  }
  return scope
}

async function reloadTemplates(): Promise<void> {
  const payload = await workspace.call({ action: 'load' })
  if (!payload || payload.connection.operatorId !== props.userId) {
    templates.value = []
    return
  }
  templates.value = filingTemplatesOf(payload.templates)
}

/** 内置模板只覆盖它自己那几项条件，其余条件（含结束日的默认值）留在表单上。 */
function applyBuiltin(template: FilingBuiltinTemplate): void {
  const resolved = applyFilingBuiltin(template, key => selectOptions(key), values.value)
  if (resolved.missing.length) {
    const names = resolved.missing.map(item => `${filingFieldLabel(item.key)}「${item.label}」`).join('、')
    templateMessage.value = `内置模板「${template.name}」里这些条件还没对上下拉：${names}。等下拉读完或点「校对最新字段」再套用。`
    return
  }
  values.value = resolved.values
  templateMessage.value = `已套用内置模板「${template.name}」。内置模板不能改，改完条件点「保存到本地」存成自己的。`
}

function applyTemplate(id: string): void {
  const builtin = selectedBuiltin.value && selectedBuiltin.value.id === id
    ? selectedBuiltin.value
    : FILING_BUILTIN_TEMPLATES.find(item => item.id === id) ?? null
  if (builtin) {
    selectedTemplateId.value = id
    applyBuiltin(builtin)
    return
  }
  const template = templates.value.find(item => item.id === id)
  selectedTemplateId.value = id
  if (!template) {
    templateMessage.value = ''
    return
  }
  values.value = filingTemplateValues(template)
  templateMessage.value = `已套用模板「${template.name}」。改完条件可以更新回去。`
}

/** 点卡片直接套用，再点一下取消选中：条件留在表单上，可以继续改或另存。 */
function toggleTemplate(id: string): void {
  if (selectedTemplateId.value === id) {
    selectedTemplateId.value = ''
    templateMessage.value = ''
    return
  }
  applyTemplate(id)
}

async function saveTemplate(): Promise<void> {
  if (savingTemplate.value) return
  const name = saveName.value.trim()
  if (!name) {
    templateMessage.value = '请填写模板名称。'
    return
  }
  const draft = filingDraftFields(values.value)
  if (!Object.keys(draft.fields).length) {
    templateMessage.value = '先填写至少一项查询条件，再保存。'
    return
  }
  const scope = liveScope()
  if (!scope) return
  const current = selectedTemplate.value
  const now = new Date().toISOString()
  const template: QueryTemplate = current ? {
    ...current,
    name,
    fields: draft.fields,
    displayValues: draft.displayValues,
    updatedAt: now
  } : {
    id: `local-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    name,
    source: 'local',
    queryType: FILING_TEMPLATE_TYPE,
    fields: draft.fields,
    displayValues: draft.displayValues,
    version: 1,
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now
  }
  savingTemplate.value = true
  templateMessage.value = '正在保存…'
  try {
    const result = await workspace.call({
      action: 'saveQueryTemplate',
      template,
      expectedScope: scope,
      expectedVersion: current ? current.version : null
    })
    if (!result?.ok) {
      templateMessage.value = result?.message || '模板没有保存。'
      return
    }
    templateMessage.value = current ? `模板「${name}」已更新。` : `模板「${name}」已保存在本机。`
    await reloadTemplates()
    selectedTemplateId.value = template.id
  } finally {
    savingTemplate.value = false
  }
}

async function deleteTemplate(): Promise<void> {
  const current = selectedTemplate.value
  if (!current || deletingTemplate.value) return
  const scope = liveScope()
  if (!scope) return
  const agreed = await confirmDialog({
    title: '删除递交查询模板',
    message: `会从本机删掉「${current.name}」。原网站没有模板功能，不受影响。`,
    confirmLabel: '删除'
  })
  if (!agreed) return
  deletingTemplate.value = true
  templateMessage.value = '正在删除…'
  try {
    const result = await workspace.call({ action: 'deleteQueryTemplate', id: current.id, expectedScope: scope })
    if (!result?.ok) {
      templateMessage.value = result?.message || '模板没有删除。'
      return
    }
    selectedTemplateId.value = ''
    saveName.value = ''
    saveNameDirty.value = false
    templateMessage.value = `模板「${current.name}」已从本机删除。`
    await reloadTemplates()
  } finally {
    deletingTemplate.value = false
  }
}
const pickers = ref<Record<string, NormalizedDictionary>>({})
const pickersReady = ref(false)
const pickerFailed = ref(false)
let pickerGeneration = 0
const pageFields = ref<FileSearchFormField[]>([])
const loadingPickers = ref(false)
const pickerMessage = ref('')
const searchState = ref<'idle' | 'loading' | 'success' | 'empty' | 'error'>('idle')
const searchMessage = ref('')
const result = ref<FilingSearchResult | null>(null)
const lastQuery = ref<FilingSearchQuery | null>(null)
const pageIndex = ref(1)
const pageSize = ref(20)
const pageSizeOptions = [
  { value: 20, label: '20' },
  { value: 50, label: '50' },
  { value: 100, label: '100' }
]
const resultsSection = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)
let generation = 0

/** 查询超时和期限监控、文件查询一样自己设，随请求带给原网站。 */
const queryTimeoutMs = ref<FileSearchTimeoutMs>(60_000)
const timeoutOptions = [
  { value: 60_000, label: '1 分钟' },
  { value: 120_000, label: '2 分钟' },
  { value: 300_000, label: '5 分钟' },
  { value: 600_000, label: '10 分钟' }
]
let timeoutDirty = false
watch(queryTimeoutMs, value => {
  timeoutDirty = true
  writeFilingTimeout(value)
}, { flush: 'sync' })

/** 页面扫描出来的 select 字段（案件流向、是否需要纸质通知书、办理类型）。 */
const SELECT_KEYS = FILING_BLOCKS.flatMap(cell => (cell.kind === 'select' ? [cell.key] : []))
/** 下拉缓存兜底，和期限监控、文件查询同一套：读到非空选项就更新缓存，读不到时先用上次的缓存。 */
const fallbackTick = ref(0)
const stopFallbackWatch = subscribeOptionFallback(() => { fallbackTick.value = optionFallbackEpoch() })

type ResultColumnKey = 'caseVolume' | 'caseName' | 'customerName' | 'customerCode' | 'applyType' | 'ctrlProc'
  | 'intDueDate' | 'filingDate' | 'caseType' | 'branchDept' | 'createUser' | 'createTime' | 'flowStatus'
type ResultColumn = { key: ResultColumnKey; label: string; mode?: 'lock' | 'grow' }

/** 列顺序对齐原站 FilingList.js 的显示列。列宽由 column-fit 按文字测量后写到 col 上。 */
const resultColumns: ResultColumn[] = [
  { key: 'caseVolume', label: '我方文号' },
  { key: 'caseName', label: '案件名称', mode: 'grow' },
  { key: 'customerName', label: '客户名称', mode: 'grow' },
  { key: 'customerCode', label: '客户代码' },
  { key: 'applyType', label: '申请类型' },
  { key: 'ctrlProc', label: '处理事项' },
  { key: 'intDueDate', label: '内部/客户期限', mode: 'lock' },
  { key: 'filingDate', label: '完成时间', mode: 'lock' },
  { key: 'caseType', label: '案件类型' },
  { key: 'branchDept', label: '案件所属分部' },
  { key: 'createUser', label: '创建人' },
  { key: 'createTime', label: '创建时间', mode: 'lock' },
  { key: 'flowStatus', label: '当前审核状态', mode: 'lock' }
]

const filledCount = computed(() => Object.values(values.value).filter(value => value.trim()).length)

function valueOf(key: string): string {
  return values.value[key] ?? ''
}
function setValue(key: string, value: string): void {
  values.value = { ...values.value, [key]: value }
}

/** 原站 TreeUser 的单选 / 多选口径集中在 shared/picker-modes：多选值逗号拼 GUID，显示文本另存 `{字段}_text`。 */
function isMulti(key: string): boolean {
  return isMultiPickerKey(key)
}

function setNamed(key: string, value: string): void {
  const ids = value.split(',').map(item => item.trim()).filter(Boolean)
  const labels = ids.map(id => choices(key).find(item => item.value === id)?.label ?? '').filter(Boolean)
  values.value = {
    ...values.value,
    [key]: ids.join(','),
    [`${key}_text`]: labels.join('，')
  }
}

function onText(key: string, event: Event): void {
  setValue(key, (event.target as HTMLInputElement).value)
}

/** 申请类型的选项按案件类型收窄，缓存也按案件类型分开存，回退时不会混进别的案件类型的选项。 */
function optionCacheKey(key: string): string {
  if (key !== 'apply_type') return key
  const caseTypeId = valueOf('case_type') || CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT.caseTypeId
  return caseTypeId ? `${key}:${caseTypeId}` : key
}

function ledgerChoices(key: string): { value: string; label: string; parent?: string }[] | null {
  return props.userId ? savedChoices(props.userId, optionCacheKey(key)) : null
}
function liveRows(key: string): { value: string; label: string; parent?: string }[] | null {
  const source = FILING_OPTION_KEYS[key]
  const dictionary = source ? pickers.value[source] : undefined
  if (!dictionary || dictionary.status === 'invalid') return null
  // 原站 ChangeForApplyType 按当前案件类型收申请类型；没选案件类型时按本环境默认的专利收。
  return choicesFromDictionary(dictionary, valueOf('case_type') || CURRENT_ENVIRONMENT.caseTypeId)
}
/** 静默校对：接口回了非空就换上；空结果和读取失败都继续用账本上的选项，界面不跟着抖。 */
function mergedRows(key: string): { value: string; label: string; parent?: string }[] {
  const source = FILING_OPTION_KEYS[key]
  const dictionary = source ? pickers.value[source] : undefined
  const live = liveRows(key)
  if (dictionary && (dictionary.status === 'ready' || dictionary.status === 'partial')) return live ?? []
  const stored = ledgerChoices(key)
  return stored?.length ? stored : (live ?? [])
}
function choices(key: string): { value: string; label: string; parent?: string }[] {
  fallbackTick.value
  return (FILING_OPTION_KEYS[key] ? mergedRows(key) : (ledgerChoices(key) ?? [])).filter(item => item.value)
}

/** select 的选项：原站页面实时扫（ScanFilingForm）优先，其次接口字典/缓存，最后用抓包快照兜底。原站这几个 select 没有接口，页面没打开时只剩兜底。 */
function selectOptions(key: string): { value: string; label: string }[] {
  fallbackTick.value
  const field = pageFields.value.find(item => item.id === key && item.control === 'select')
  const scanned = (field?.options ?? []).filter(item => item.value)
  const fromDictionary = choices(key).filter(item => item.value)
  const builtin = (FILING_SELECTS[key] ?? []).filter(item => item.value)
  const rows = FILING_OPTION_KEYS[key] ? fromDictionary : scanned.length ? scanned : fromDictionary.length ? fromDictionary : builtin
  return [{ value: '', label: '不限' }, ...rows.map(item => ({ value: item.value, label: item.label }))]
}

/** 这个账号已经存下非空选项的字段。 */
function cachedOptionKeys(): string[] {
  if (!props.userId) return []
  const keys = new Set([...Object.keys(FILING_OPTION_KEYS), ...SELECT_KEYS])
  return [...keys].filter(key => savedChoices(props.userId, optionCacheKey(key)))
}
/** 只要有任一字段存过非空选项，这轮拉取就整个界面走静默：不挡界面、非空才更新、拉不到用账本兜底。 */
const ledgerPresent = computed(() => {
  fallbackTick.value
  return Boolean(props.userId) && Object.keys(FILING_OPTION_KEYS).some(key => hasSavedChoices(props.userId, optionCacheKey(key)))
})
const FILING_CELL_LABELS: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(FILING_BLOCKS.flatMap(cell => filingCellKeys(cell).map(key => [key, cell.label] as [string, string])))
function optionFieldLabel(key: string): string {
  const base = key.split(':')[0]!
  return FILING_CELL_LABELS[key] ?? FILING_CELL_LABELS[base] ?? key
}
function treeChoices(key: string): { value: string; label: string; parent?: string }[] {
  const options = choices(key)
  return hasOptionTree(options) ? options : []
}
function optionsFor(key: string): { value: string; label: string; parent?: string }[] {
  return [{ value: '', label: '不限' }, ...choices(key)]
}
function optionLabel(key: string, value: string): string {
  const option = choices(key).find(item => item.value === value)
  return option?.label ?? ''
}

function optionStatus(key: string): 'loading' | 'ready' | 'empty' | 'partial' | 'invalid' {
  // 账号有账本就整个界面走静默校对：拉取期间所有字段照常可选，拉不到也用账本兜底，不进 loading/失败态。
  if (ledgerPresent.value) return choices(key).length ? 'ready' : 'empty'
  if (loadingPickers.value || (!pickersReady.value && !pickerFailed.value)) return 'loading'
  if (pickerFailed.value) return 'invalid'
  return pickers.value[FILING_OPTION_KEYS[key] ?? '']?.status ?? 'invalid'
}
function unavailableOptions(fields: Record<string, string>): string[] {
  return Object.keys(FILING_OPTION_KEYS).filter(key => {
    if (key === 'business_coop') return false // 原站明确允许手填签约单位。
    const ids = (fields[key] ?? '').split(',').map(id => id.trim()).filter(Boolean)
    return ids.length > 0 && (!['ready', 'partial'].includes(optionStatus(key)) || ids.some(id => !choices(key).some(option => option.value === id)))
  })
}
const unavailableFields = computed(() => unavailableOptions(values.value))
async function loadPickers(force: boolean, manual = false): Promise<void> {
  const bridge = activeBridge()
  if (!bridge || (!props.canSearch && !props.manage) || loadingPickers.value) return
  if (!force && pickersReady.value) return
  const pickerTicket = ++pickerGeneration
  const userId = props.userId
  const current = () => pickerTicket === pickerGeneration && userId === props.userId
  loadingPickers.value = true
  pickerFailed.value = false
  // 静默拉取不放进度文案：字段照常可选，完成后只在有更新或拉不到时说话。
  pickerMessage.value = ''
  try {
    const [dict, form] = await Promise.all([
      bridge.request({ type: MessageType.LoadDictionary, payload: { kind: 'picker', force } }),
      bridge.request({ type: MessageType.ScanFilingForm })
    ])
    if (!current()) return
    let changed: string[] = []
    const failures: string[] = []
    if (dict.type === MessageType.DictionaryResult && dict.payload.ok && dict.payload.data.kind === 'picker') {
      pickers.value = dict.payload.data.dictionaries
      pickersReady.value = true
      if (props.userId) {
        // 申请类型按案件类型收窄后单独缓存；其余下拉按表单键存进回退。非空才更新：空结果不覆盖账本上已有的选项。
        const fields = { ...FILING_OPTION_KEYS }
        delete fields.apply_type
        changed = [
          ...rememberDictionaries(props.userId, fields, dict.payload.data.dictionaries, true),
          ...rememberDictionaries(props.userId, { [optionCacheKey('apply_type')]: FILING_OPTION_KEYS.apply_type! }, dict.payload.data.dictionaries, true)
        ]
      }
    } else {
      pickerFailed.value = true
      failures.push(dict.type === MessageType.DictionaryResult && !dict.payload.ok
        ? dict.payload.error.message
        : cachedOptionKeys().length ? '接口下拉没有读到，先用上次读到的选项。' : '接口下拉没有读到，文本条件仍可查询。')
    }
    if (form.type === MessageType.FilingFormResult) {
      // 空扫描结果不覆盖上一次读到的下拉；只有扫到非空选项才更新缓存。
      const scanned = form.payload.fields
      if (scanned.length) {
        pageFields.value = scanned
        if (props.userId) changed.push(...rememberFormFields(props.userId, scanned))
      }
    }
    pickerMessage.value = describeOptionPull({
      updatedLabels: [...new Set(changed)].map(optionFieldLabel),
      failures,
      manual,
      hasLedger: ledgerPresent.value
    })
  } catch {
    if (!current()) return
    pickerFailed.value = true
    pickerMessage.value = describeOptionPull({ updatedLabels: [], failures: ['下拉选项没有读到，文本条件仍可查询。'], manual, hasLedger: ledgerPresent.value })
  } finally {
    if (current()) loadingPickers.value = false
  }
}

function messageForError(code: string, message: string): string {
  if (code === 'SESSION_EXPIRED') return 'EASY 登录已失效，请在原网站重新登录后检测。'
  if (code === 'AUTH_UNKNOWN') return '无法确认当前登录状态，请重试。'
  if (code === 'REQUEST_TIMEOUT') return `原网站查询太慢，没有在 ${queryTimeoutMs.value / 60_000} 分钟内返回。可以把超时时间调长，或把条件写具体一点再查。`
  if (code === 'NETWORK_ERROR') return '网络异常，请检查 EASY 网站连接。'
  return message || '请求失败，请稍后重试。'
}

async function showResults(): Promise<void> {
  const section = resultsSection.value
  const viewport = section?.closest<HTMLElement>('.body')
  if (section && viewport) {
    viewport.scrollTop += section.getBoundingClientRect().top - viewport.getBoundingClientRect().top
  }
}

async function executeSearch(query: FilingSearchQuery): Promise<void> {
  if (unavailableOptions(query.fields ?? {}).length) {
    pickerMessage.value = '原选项当前不可用，请重新读取选项或显式清除后查询。'
    return
  }
  const bridge = activeBridge()
  if (!bridge) {
    searchState.value = 'error'
    searchMessage.value = '页面通信不可用，查询没有发出。请重新打开这一页再试。'
    void showResults()
    return
  }
  if (!props.canSearch) return
  const current = ++generation
  lastQuery.value = query
  emit('searched', query)
  searchState.value = 'loading'
  searchMessage.value = ''
  result.value = null
  try {
    const response = await bridge.request({
      type: MessageType.SearchFiling,
      payload: { query, timeoutMs: fileSearchTimeoutMs(queryTimeoutMs.value) }
    })
    if (current !== generation) return
    if (response.type !== MessageType.SearchFilingResult) {
      searchState.value = 'error'
      searchMessage.value = response.type === MessageType.Error ? response.payload.message : '递交查询返回了意外结果。'
      return
    }
    if (!response.payload.ok) {
      searchState.value = 'error'
      searchMessage.value = messageForError(response.payload.error.code, response.payload.error.message)
      return
    }
    const data = response.payload.data
    result.value = data
    searchState.value = data.total === 0 ? 'empty' : 'success'
    await showResults()
  } catch {
    if (current !== generation) return
    searchState.value = 'error'
    searchMessage.value = '递交查询通信失败，请重试。'
  }
}

function search(): void {
  if (unavailableFields.value.length) { pickerMessage.value = '原选项当前不可用，请重新读取选项或显式清除后查询。'; return }
  const draft = filingDraftFields(values.value)
  if (!Object.keys(draft.fields).length) {
    searchState.value = 'error'
    searchMessage.value = '请输入查询条件。'
    result.value = null
    lastQuery.value = null
    void showResults()
    return
  }
  clearSelected()
  failedPages.value = []
  selectionNotice.value = ''
  void executeSearch({ ...draft, pageIndex: 1, pageSize: pageSize.value })
}
function refresh(): void {
  if (lastQuery.value) void executeSearch({ ...lastQuery.value, pageIndex: pageIndex.value })
}
function changePageSize(): void {
  if (!lastQuery.value || !props.canSearch || ![20, 50, 100].includes(pageSize.value)) return
  pageIndex.value = 1
  void executeSearch({ ...lastQuery.value, pageIndex: 1, pageSize: pageSize.value })
}
function page(delta: number): void {
  if (!lastQuery.value || !result.value || searchState.value === 'loading') return
  const next = pageIndex.value + delta
  if (next < 1 || next > result.value.totalPages) return
  pageIndex.value = next
  void executeSearch({ ...lastQuery.value, pageIndex: next })
}
function reset(): void {
  generation += 1
  values.value = { ...filingDateDefaults() }
  result.value = null
  lastQuery.value = null
  pageIndex.value = 1
  searchState.value = 'idle'
  searchMessage.value = ''
  clearSelected()
  failedPages.value = []
  selectionNotice.value = ''
  selectedTemplateId.value = ''
  saveName.value = ''
  saveNameDirty.value = false
  templateMessage.value = ''
}
function rowNo(index: number): number {
  return (pageIndex.value - 1) * pageSize.value + index + 1
}
function cellText(row: FilingSearchRow, key: ResultColumnKey): string {
  return row[key]?.trim() ?? ''
}

const resultsTableHost = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)

/**
 * 已勾选的递交。几万行不进响应式：存普通 Map，只靠一个版本号驱动重绘；
 * 勾选也不整体拷贝，选中几万条时单行点一下照样轻快。
 */
const selectedMap = new Map<string, FilingSearchRow>()
const selectedVersion = ref(0)
const selectingAll = ref(false)
const selectedCount = computed(() => {
  void selectedVersion.value
  return selectedMap.size
})

function rowKey(row: FilingSearchRow): string {
  return row.filingId || `${row.caseVolume}|${row.procId}|${row.createTime}`
}
function isSelected(row: FilingSearchRow): boolean {
  void selectedVersion.value
  return selectedMap.has(rowKey(row))
}
function toggleRow(row: FilingSearchRow, on: boolean): void {
  const key = rowKey(row)
  if (on) selectedMap.set(key, row)
  else selectedMap.delete(key)
  selectedVersion.value += 1
}
function selectPage(on: boolean): void {
  for (const row of result.value?.items ?? []) {
    const key = rowKey(row)
    if (on) selectedMap.set(key, row)
    else selectedMap.delete(key)
  }
  selectedVersion.value += 1
}
function clearSelected(): void {
  selectedMap.clear()
  selectedVersion.value += 1
}

/** 查询结果特别大时先劝一句再继续，避免不加条件就全选导致取数和导出拖很久。 */
async function confirmHuge(count: number): Promise<boolean> {
  if (count <= 1000) return true
  return confirmDialog({
    title: '查询结果超过 1000 条',
    message: `这次有 ${count} 条递交记录，超过 1000 条。建议加查询条件缩小范围后再全选和导出；也可以继续，但取数会很久。`,
    confirmLabel: '继续'
  })
}

const failedPages = ref<number[]>([])
const selectionNotice = ref('')

type PageFetch = FilingPageResult

/** 一页只调一次；重试、并行、漏页统计都在 runFilingPages 里。 */
async function fetchPage(bridge: MessageBridge, query: FilingSearchQuery, page: number, size: number): Promise<PageFetch> {
  try {
    const response = await bridge.request({
      type: MessageType.SearchFiling,
      // batch：批量拉页不占「新查询取消旧查询」的槽，并行几页才不会互相 abort。
      payload: { query: { ...query, pageIndex: page, pageSize: size }, timeoutMs: fileSearchTimeoutMs(queryTimeoutMs.value), batch: true as const }
    })
    if (response.type === MessageType.SearchFilingResult && response.payload.ok) {
      return { ok: true, rows: response.payload.data.items }
    }
    const message = response.type === MessageType.SearchFilingResult && !response.payload.ok
      ? response.payload.error.message
      : response.type === MessageType.Error ? response.payload.message : '这一页没有返回结果。'
    return { ok: false, session: /登录|会话已变化|尚未确认|尚未连接|标签页已失效/.test(message) }
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, session: false }
  }
}

function describeMissed(pages: number[]): string {
  return `第 ${pages.slice(0, 8).join('、')}${pages.length > 8 ? ' 等' : ''} 页`
}

/** 全选所有翻页的进度：和取数同一根彩虹条，动词换成「翻页」。 */
const paging = { startedAt: 0, total: 0, done: 0 }

/** 全选所有进行中把「预计几点完成」也写在按钮旁，翻页快时彩虹条一闪而过也看得到。 */
const pagingHint = computed(() => {
  if (!selectingAll.value) return ''
  return taskCheckProgress.eta ? `（全选所有进行中，预计 ${taskCheckProgress.eta} 完成）` : '（全选所有进行中…）'
})

function paintPaging(status: 'run' | 'done'): void {
  paintTaskCheckProgress(paging.done, paging.total, paging.startedAt, status, '翻页')
}

function tickPage(): void {
  paging.done += 1
  paintPaging(paging.done >= paging.total ? 'done' : 'run')
}

function collectPages(bridge: MessageBridge, query: FilingSearchQuery, pages: number[], size: number, onEach?: () => void): Promise<number[]> {
  return runFilingPages(pages, page => fetchPage(bridge, query, page, size), {
    onPage: (_page, rows) => {
      for (const row of rows) selectedMap.set(rowKey(row), row)
      selectedVersion.value += 1
      onEach?.()
    }
  })
}

/** 全选所有页：只按上次的条件把每一页的列表行拉回来（翻页），边拉边计数、彩虹条报进度；
 * 有漏的自动兜一轮，再不行留按钮补。导出取数不在这里打，点「导出 Excel」才开始。 */
async function selectAllPages(): Promise<void> {
  const total = result.value?.total ?? 0
  const bridge = activeBridge()
  const query = lastQuery.value
  if (!bridge || !props.canSearch || selectingAll.value || !query || !total) return
  if (!(await confirmHuge(total))) return
  selectingAll.value = true
  selectionNotice.value = ''
  failedPages.value = []
  try {
    const size = 100
    const all = Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(total / size) }, (_, index) => index + 1)
    paging.startedAt = Date.now()
    paging.total = all.length
    paging.done = 0
    paintPaging('run')
    let missed = await collectPages(bridge, query, all, size, tickPage)
    if (missed.length) missed = await collectPages(bridge, query, missed, size, tickPage)
    failedPages.value = missed
    paintPaging('done')
    if (missed.length) {
      selectionNotice.value = `全选所有有 ${missed.length} 页没读到（${describeMissed(missed)}）。已选的不受影响，点「重试没读到的页」补齐。`
    }
  } finally {
    selectingAll.value = false
  }
}

/** 容灾补齐：只重拉没读到的页，已选的不动。 */
async function retryFailedPages(): Promise<void> {
  const bridge = activeBridge()
  const query = lastQuery.value
  const pages = failedPages.value
  if (!bridge || !query || selectingAll.value || !pages.length) return
  selectingAll.value = true
  try {
    // 重试这一轮自己的件数和起点，不然接在上一轮 100% 后面就再也算不出预计完成时间。
    paging.startedAt = Date.now()
    paging.total = pages.length
    paging.done = 0
    paintPaging('run')
    let missed = await collectPages(bridge, query, pages, 100, tickPage)
    if (missed.length) missed = await collectPages(bridge, query, missed, 100, tickPage)
    failedPages.value = missed
    paintPaging('done')
    selectionNotice.value = missed.length
      ? `还有 ${missed.length} 页没读到（${describeMissed(missed)}），可以再点一次重试。`
      : '没读到的页都补齐了。'
  } finally {
    selectingAll.value = false
  }
}

async function exportSelected(): Promise<void> {
  const rows = [...selectedMap.values()]
  if (!rows.length) return
  if (!(await confirmHuge(rows.length))) return
  emit('export', rows)
}
const colWidths = ref<number[]>([])
const tableStyle = computed(() => {
  const total = colWidths.value.reduce((sum, width) => sum + width, 0)
  return { width: `${total}px`, minWidth: '100%' }
})
let ruler = createTextRuler()
let observer: ResizeObserver | undefined

function textWidth(text: string, source: Element | null): number {
  return ruler.width(text, source)
}

/** 和期限表同一套：按文字量出每列下限和内容宽，交给 column-fit 分配。 */
function columnSpecs(header: Element | null, body: Element | null): ColumnFit[] {
  const rows = result.value?.items ?? []
  const specs: ColumnFit[] = []
  const add = (title: string, values: string[], mode?: 'lock' | 'grow'): void => {
    const min = textWidth(title, header) + 16
    let content = min
    for (const value of values) content = Math.max(content, textWidth(value, body) + 16)
    specs.push({ min, content, lock: mode === 'lock', grow: mode === 'grow' })
  }
  // 勾选列固定一格宽，不参与文字测量。
  specs.push({ min: 36, content: 36, lock: true })
  add('序号', rows.map((_, index) => String(rowNo(index))), 'lock')
  for (const column of resultColumns) {
    add(column.label, rows.map(row => cellText(row, column.key)), column.mode)
  }
  return specs
}

function layoutColumns(): void {
  const root = resultsTableHost.value
  const table = root?.querySelector('table')
  if (!root || !table) return
  if (!result.value?.items.length) {
    colWidths.value = []
    return
  }
  const container = root.clientWidth
  if (container <= 0) return
  const header = table.querySelector('thead th') || table
  const cell = table.querySelector('tbody td') || header
  colWidths.value = fitColumnWidths(columnSpecs(header, cell), container)
}

const measureKey = computed(() => {
  const rows = result.value?.items ?? []
  return [searchState.value, pageIndex.value, pageSize.value,
    ...rows.map(row => resultColumns.map(column => cellText(row, column.key)).join('|'))].join('~')
})
watch(measureKey, () => layoutColumns(), { flush: 'post' })

watch(() => props.userId, () => {
  pickerGeneration += 1
  pickers.value = {}
  pickersReady.value = false
  pickerFailed.value = false
  pageFields.value = []
  pickerMessage.value = ''
  loadingPickers.value = false
  templates.value = []
  selectedTemplateId.value = ''
  saveName.value = ''
  saveNameDirty.value = false
  templateMessage.value = ''
  if (!props.userId) return
  activateOptionFallback(props.userId)
  void hydrateOptionFallback(props.userId)
  void loadPickers(false)
  void reloadTemplates()
}, { immediate: true })

watch(selectedTemplateId, () => {
  saveNameDirty.value = false
  saveName.value = selectedTemplate.value?.name ?? selectedBuiltin.value?.name ?? ''
})

onMounted(() => {
  void readFilingTimeout().then(value => {
    if (!timeoutDirty) queryTimeoutMs.value = value
  })
  layoutColumns()
  observer = new ResizeObserver(() => layoutColumns())
  if (resultsTableHost.value) observer.observe(resultsTableHost.value)
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  generation += 1
  stopFallbackWatch()
  observer?.disconnect()
  ruler.dispose()
})
</script>

<template>
  <div class="filing-search-query">
    <section class="card query-conditions" aria-label="递交查询条件">
      <div class="section-heading">
        <strong>查询条件</strong>
        <span class="inline-actions">
          <label class="query-timeout">超时时间
            <ThemeSelect v-model="queryTimeoutMs" :options="timeoutOptions" />
          </label>
          <button type="button" class="text-button" :disabled="(!canSearch && !manage) || loadingPickers" @click="loadPickers(true, true)">校对最新字段</button>
        </span>
      </div>
      <ul v-if="templateCards.length" class="template-picks" aria-label="递交查询模板">
        <li v-for="item in templateCards" :key="item.id">
          <button type="button" :class="{ on: selectedTemplateId === item.id }" :title="item.name" @click="toggleTemplate(item.id)">
            <b v-hint.clip="item.name">{{ item.name }}</b>
            <small>{{ item.builtin ? '内置' : '本地' }}</small>
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>
      <div class="template-save-row" aria-label="递交模板操作">
        <label>模板名称<input v-model="saveName" type="text" maxlength="80" @input="saveNameDirty = true" /></label>
        <button type="button" class="text-button" :disabled="savingTemplate" @click="saveTemplate">{{ savingTemplate ? '正在保存…' : selectedTemplate ? '更新模板' : '保存到本地' }}</button>
        <button type="button" class="text-button" :disabled="!selectedTemplate || deletingTemplate" @click="deleteTemplate">{{ deletingTemplate ? '正在删除…' : '删除模板' }}</button>
      </div>
      <p v-if="templateMessage" class="hint">{{ templateMessage }}</p>
      <p class="hint">递交查询模板只存在本机：原站没有模板功能，保存和删除都不会写原网站。</p>
      <p v-if="loadingPickers && !pickersReady && !ledgerPresent" class="hint">正在向原网站读取递交查询下拉…</p>
      <p v-else-if="pickerMessage" class="hint">{{ pickerMessage }}</p>
      <div class="query-grid">
        <template v-for="cell in FILING_BLOCKS" :key="filingCellKeys(cell).join('-')">
          <label v-if="cell.kind === 'text'" class="query-cell">
            <span>{{ cell.label }}</span>
            <span class="limit-input">
              <input :value="valueOf(cell.key)" type="text" :placeholder="cell.hint ?? ''" @input="onText(cell.key, $event)" />
            </span>
          </label>
          <label v-else-if="cell.kind === 'named'" class="query-cell">
            <span>{{ cell.label }}</span>
            <TreeOptionSelect v-if="cell.key !== 'business_coop' || choices(cell.key).length" :model-value="valueOf(cell.key)" :multiple="isMulti(cell.key)" :options="choices(cell.key)" :status="optionStatus(cell.key)" :empty-text="`当前账号未配置${cell.label}`" @retry="loadPickers(true, true)" @update:model-value="setNamed(cell.key, String($event))" />
            <ThemeSelect v-else-if="choices(cell.key).length || cell.key !== 'business_coop'" :model-value="valueOf(cell.key)" :value-label="optionLabel(cell.key, valueOf(cell.key))" :options="optionsFor(cell.key)" @open="loadPickers(false)" @update:model-value="setNamed(cell.key, String($event))" />
            <input v-else :value="valueOf(cell.key)" type="text" placeholder="签约单位下拉未读到，可直接填值" @input="onText(cell.key, $event)" />
          </label>
          <label v-else-if="cell.kind === 'select'" class="query-cell">
            <span>{{ cell.label }}</span>
            <TreeOptionSelect v-if="FILING_OPTION_KEYS[cell.key]" :model-value="valueOf(cell.key)" :options="choices(cell.key)" :multiple="false" :status="optionStatus(cell.key)" :empty-text="`当前账号未配置${cell.label}`" @retry="loadPickers(true, true)" @update:model-value="setValue(cell.key, String($event))" />
            <ThemeSelect v-else :model-value="valueOf(cell.key)" :options="selectOptions(cell.key)" @update:model-value="setValue(cell.key, String($event))" />
          </label>
          <div v-else-if="cell.kind === 'dates'" class="query-cell">
            <span>{{ cell.label }}</span>
            <span class="date-pair">
              <WDatePicker :id="cell.start" :model-value="valueOf(cell.start)" :max="valueOf(cell.end)" placeholder="开始" @update:model-value="setValue(cell.start, String($event))" />
              <em>到</em>
              <WDatePicker :id="cell.end" :model-value="valueOf(cell.end)" :min="valueOf(cell.start)" placeholder="结束" @update:model-value="setValue(cell.end, String($event))" />
            </span>
          </div>
        </template>
      </div>
      <div class="form-actions">
        <span class="hint">已填 {{ filledCount }} 项条件。处理事项可多选时一次只带一项。</span>
        <button class="ghost" type="button" @click="reset">重置</button>
        <button v-if="!manage" class="solid" type="button" :disabled="!canSearch || searchState === 'loading'" @click="search">查询</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section v-if="!manage" ref="resultsSection" class="card filing-results" aria-label="递交查询结果">
      <div class="section-heading">
        <strong>查询结果</strong>
        <label class="page-size">每页数量
          <ThemeSelect v-model="pageSize" :disabled="!canSearch || searchState === 'loading'" :options="pageSizeOptions" @change="changePageSize" />
        </label>
        <button type="button" class="text-button" :disabled="!canSearch || !lastQuery || searchState === 'loading'" @click="refresh">刷新</button>
      </div>
      <div v-if="result" class="toolbar limit-bar">
        <span class="sheet-count">共 {{ result.total }} 条递交记录</span>
        <button type="button" class="ghost" :disabled="searchState === 'loading'" @click="selectPage(true)">全选本页</button>
        <button type="button" class="ghost" :disabled="searchState === 'loading'" @click="selectPage(false)">取消本页</button>
        <button type="button" class="ghost" :disabled="searchState === 'loading' || selectingAll" @click="selectAllPages">{{ selectingAll ? '正在全选…' : '全选所有' }}</button>
        <button type="button" class="ghost" :disabled="searchState === 'loading' || selectedCount === 0" @click="clearSelected">取消所有</button>
        <span class="hint">已选 {{ selectedCount }} 件{{ pagingHint }}</span>
        <button v-if="failedPages.length" type="button" class="ghost" :disabled="selectingAll" @click="retryFailedPages">重试没读到的 {{ failedPages.length }} 页</button>
        <button type="button" class="solid tiny" :disabled="selectedCount === 0 || selectingAll" @click="exportSelected">导出 Excel</button>
      </div>
      <p v-if="selectionNotice" class="error" role="alert">{{ selectionNotice }}</p>
      <p v-if="searchState === 'idle'" class="hint">输入条件后查询递交记录。</p>
      <p v-else-if="searchState === 'loading'" class="hint" role="status">正在查询…</p>
      <p v-else-if="searchState === 'error'" class="error" role="alert">{{ searchMessage }}</p>
      <p v-else-if="searchState === 'empty'" class="hint" role="status">没有符合条件的递交记录。</p>
      <template v-else-if="result">
        <div ref="resultsTableHost" class="fit-table filing-cols">
          <table class="grid" :style="tableStyle">
            <colgroup>
              <col v-for="(width, index) in colWidths" :key="index" :style="{ width: width + 'px' }" />
            </colgroup>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th class="check">
                  <input type="checkbox" aria-label="全选本页" :checked="result.items.length > 0 && result.items.every(isSelected)" @change="selectPage(($event.target as HTMLInputElement).checked)" />
                </th>
                <th class="seq">序号</th>
                <th v-for="column in resultColumns" :key="column.key">{{ column.label }}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr v-for="(row, index) in result.items" :key="row.filingId || `${row.caseVolume}-${index}`">
                <td class="check">
                  <input type="checkbox" :aria-label="row.caseVolume || row.caseName" :checked="isSelected(row)" @change="toggleRow(row, ($event.target as HTMLInputElement).checked)" />
                </td>
                <td class="seq">{{ rowNo(index) }}</td>
                <td v-for="column in resultColumns" :key="column.key">
                  <span class="clip" v-hint.clip="cellText(row, column.key)">{{ cellText(row, column.key) }}</span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        <nav class="pagination" aria-label="递交分页">
          <button type="button" :disabled="pageIndex <= 1" @click="page(-1)">上一页</button>
          <span>第 {{ pageIndex }} / {{ Math.max(result.totalPages, 1) }} 页</span>
          <button type="button" :disabled="pageIndex >= result.totalPages" @click="page(1)">下一页</button>
        </nav>
      </template>
    </section>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import LimitPage from '../../shell/pages/LimitPage.vue'
import LimitQuerySection from '../../floating/LimitQuerySection.vue'
import type { LimitMonitorResult, LimitMonitorRow } from '../../api/limit-monitor-types'
import { isLimitMonitorType, type LimitMonitorQuery } from '../../api/limit-monitor-params'
import { MAILED_UNFINISHED_REVIEW, SKIP_SEND_REVIEW } from '../../customer/pct-flow-status'
import { clonePctTask, readWorkflowTask, writeWorkflowTask } from '../../customer/pct-sheet'
import { limitMailItems, limitMailLetterLabel, limitMailProcIds, limitMailSubmitShouldHalt, runLimitMailSubmit, runMailLetterPool, selectionNeedsAddressChoice, type LimitMailSubmitResult } from '../../customer/limit-mail-submit'
import { beginProgress, classifySubmitText, clipCompany, confirmDialog, endProgress, logProgress, noteProgress, openSummary, progressSummaryLine, tallyProgress, warnBusinessRecipients } from '../dialog'
import { splitCaseVolumes } from '../../customer/volume-list'
import { isQueryGuid } from '../../query/query-validator'
import { flushRecovery, holdRecovery, peekRecovery, recallRecovery, scheduleRecovery, systemScope } from '../../recovery/wal-ledger'
import { sceneOwnerChanged } from '../../shared/connection'
import { readLimitTimeout } from '../../api/query-timeout'
import { MessageType, type MessageBridge } from '../../shared/message'
import { useMailConcurrency } from '../../settings/use-mail-concurrency'
import { useWorkspace } from '../composables/useWorkspace'
import { isWriteSwitchOpen, isWriteSwitchReady } from '../../settings/write-switch'
import { useWriteSwitch } from '../../settings/use-write-switch'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  bridge?: MessageBridge
  userId: string
  connected: boolean
  seed?: Record<string, string> | null
  procQueries?: Array<{ id: string; volumes: string }>
  seedToken?: number
  caseVolume?: string
  sheetRows?: Array<{ ourVolume: string; procLabel?: string; mailTypeId?: string; customerName?: string; contactName?: string; iprName?: string; leadName?: string; mailTo?: string; mailCc?: string; iprCarried?: true; contactCarried?: true; leadCarried?: true; iprArbitrated?: true }>
  recipientMode?: 'ipr' | 'lead'
  inventorCustomers?: string[]
  flowByKey?: Record<string, string>
  /** 下面的核对已经在读同一批流程。上表不再为这 40 行另开一轮流程图。 */
  flowChecking?: boolean
  /** 「已发文，事项未管制完成日」的行是否允许勾选提交。默认允许，提交前会弹警示框。 */
  allowMailedUnfinished?: boolean
  /** 发文映射或这一页选中的默认发件人。草稿没有发件邮箱时写入。 */
  senderId?: string
}>(), { flowChecking: false, allowMailedUnfinished: true })

const { open: writesOpen, ready: writesReady } = useWriteSwitch()
const { concurrency } = useMailConcurrency()

const emit = defineEmits<{
  confirm: [procIds: string[]]
  result: [payload: { items: LimitMonitorRow[]; gates: Record<string, 'open' | 'pending' | 'done'>; checking: boolean; message: string }]
  refreshStatus: [payload: { targets: Array<{ caseVolume: string; procLabel: string }>; abnormal: Array<{ caseVolume: string; procLabel: string }> }]
}>()

const loading = ref(false)
const message = ref('')
const rows = ref<LimitMonitorRow[]>([])
const gates = ref<Record<string, 'open' | 'pending' | 'done'>>({})
const checkingGates = ref(false)
let gateToken = 0
const total = ref(0)
const pageIndex = ref(1)
const pageSize = ref(10)
const selected = ref<string[]>([])
const confirmedIds = ref<string[]>([])
const closedIds = ref(new Set<string>())
const hasIprGap = computed(() => selectionNeedsAddressChoice(
  rows.value,
  props.sheetRows ?? [],
  selected.value,
  rows.value.filter(row => rowCanConfirm(row.procId)).map(row => row.procId),
  props.recipientMode ?? (() => {
    const stored = readWorkflowTask()
    return stored?.recipientMode === 'lead' || stored?.recipientMode === 'ipr' ? stored.recipientMode : 'ipr'
  })()
))
const sheetMerged = ref(false)
const lastQuery = ref<Omit<LimitMonitorQuery, 'pageIndex' | 'pageSize'> | null>(null)
const templateId = ref('')
const mergedPageSize = 100
const pagedRows = computed(() => {
  if (!sheetMerged.value) return rows.value
  const start = (pageIndex.value - 1) * mergedPageSize
  return rows.value.slice(start, start + mergedPageSize)
})

function sheetVolumeKey(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/\s/g, '').toUpperCase()
}

const plainProcIds = computed(() => {
  const marked = new Set<string>()
  for (const row of props.sheetRows ?? []) {
    if (!row.iprArbitrated && !row.iprCarried && !row.contactCarried && !row.leadCarried) continue
    marked.add(`${sheetVolumeKey(row.ourVolume)}\n${(row.procLabel ?? '').trim()}`)
  }
  const ids: string[] = []
  for (const row of rows.value) {
    const key = `${sheetVolumeKey(row.caseVolume)}\n${row.ctrlProc.trim()}`
    if (!marked.has(key) && isQueryGuid(row.procId)) ids.push(row.procId)
  }
  return ids
})

const flowByProc = computed(() => {
  const source = props.flowByKey ?? {}
  const out: Record<string, string> = {}
  for (const row of rows.value) {
    const text = source[`${sheetVolumeKey(row.caseVolume)}\n${row.ctrlProc.trim()}`]
    if (text) out[row.procId] = text
  }
  return out
})

type SearchInput = Omit<LimitMonitorQuery, 'pageIndex' | 'pageSize'> & { reset?: boolean; templateId?: string; page?: number }

function readQueryDesk(): unknown | null {
  if (!rows.value.length && !selected.value.length && !confirmedIds.value.length) return null
  const owner = props.userId
  return {
    version: 1,
    operatorId: isQueryGuid(owner) ? owner.toLowerCase() : '',
    rows: rows.value,
    gates: { ...gates.value },
    selected: selected.value,
    confirmedIds: confirmedIds.value,
    message: message.value,
    total: total.value,
    pageIndex: pageIndex.value,
    pageSize: pageSize.value,
    sheetMerged: sheetMerged.value,
    lastQuery: lastQuery.value
  }
}

let sceneOwner = ''

function applyQueryDesk(payload: unknown): void {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object' || rows.value.length) return
  const desk = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  if (desk.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(desk.rows) || !desk.rows.length) return
  const owner = typeof desk.operatorId === 'string' ? desk.operatorId.toLowerCase() : ''
  if (isQueryGuid(props.userId) && owner && props.userId.toLowerCase() !== owner) return
  if (owner) sceneOwner = owner
  rows.value = desk.rows as LimitMonitorRow[]
  gates.value = desk.gates && typeof desk.gates === 'object' ? desk.gates as Record<string, 'open' | 'pending' | 'done'> : {}
  selected.value = Array.isArray(desk.selected) ? desk.selected.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string') : []
  confirmedIds.value = Array.isArray(desk.confirmedIds) ? desk.confirmedIds.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string') : []
  if (typeof desk.message === 'string' && desk.message) message.value = desk.message
  if (typeof desk.total === 'number') total.value = desk.total
  if (typeof desk.pageIndex === 'number' && desk.pageIndex > 0) pageIndex.value = desk.pageIndex
  sheetMerged.value = desk.sheetMerged === true
  lastQuery.value = desk.lastQuery && typeof desk.lastQuery === 'object' ? desk.lastQuery as Omit<LimitMonitorQuery, 'pageIndex' | 'pageSize'> : null
  if (!message.value) message.value = '登录中断前的查询结果已经从本机恢复账本找回。'
  publish()
}

const { connection, rules } = useWorkspace()
let queryScope = systemScope(connection.value.easyOrigin, 'workflow')
let parkingQuery = false

function pokeQuery(): void {
  if (parkingQuery) return
  scheduleRecovery('limit-query', queryScope, readQueryDesk)
}

watch(() => connection.value.easyOrigin, (next, previous) => {
  if (next === previous) return
  if (!previous) {
    queryScope = systemScope(next, 'workflow')
    if (rows.value.length) return
    const arriving = queryScope
    void recallRecovery('limit-query', arriving).then(async saved => {
      if (!saved) saved = await recallRecovery('limit-query', 'workflow')
      if (queryScope !== arriving || rows.value.length) return
      applyQueryDesk(saved)
      pokeQuery()
    }).catch(() => { /* 这个系统还没有账本 */ })
    return
  }
  parkingQuery = true
  const payload = readQueryDesk()
  holdRecovery('limit-query', systemScope(previous, 'workflow'), payload)
  clearProcQuery()
  queryScope = systemScope(next, 'workflow')
  const cached = peekRecovery('limit-query', queryScope)
  const arriving = queryScope
  if (cached) applyQueryDesk(cached)
  parkingQuery = false
  pokeQuery()
  if (cached === undefined) {
    void recallRecovery('limit-query', arriving).then(saved => {
      if (queryScope !== arriving || rows.value.length) return
      applyQueryDesk(saved)
      pokeQuery()
    }).catch(() => { /* 这个系统还没有账本 */ })
  }
})

watch(() => connection.value.operatorId, (next, previous) => {
  if (next === previous) return
  if (!next) return
  const owner = sceneOwner || (isQueryGuid(previous) ? previous.toLowerCase() : '')
  if (!sceneOwnerChanged(owner, next)) {
    if (isQueryGuid(next) && !sceneOwner) sceneOwner = next.toLowerCase()
    return
  }
  parkingQuery = true
  const payload = readQueryDesk()
  const origin = connection.value.easyOrigin
  holdRecovery('limit-query', systemScope(origin, `${owner}|workflow`), payload)
  holdRecovery('limit-query', queryScope, null)
  clearProcQuery()
  lastQuery.value = null
  sceneOwner = next.toLowerCase()
  queryScope = systemScope(origin, `${sceneOwner}|workflow`)
  const cached = peekRecovery('limit-query', queryScope)
  const arriving = queryScope
  if (cached) applyQueryDesk(cached)
  parkingQuery = false
  pokeQuery()
  if (cached === undefined) {
    void recallRecovery('limit-query', arriving).then(saved => {
      if (queryScope !== arriving || rows.value.length) return
      applyQueryDesk(saved)
      pokeQuery()
    }).catch(() => { /* 新账号还没有这份查询 */ })
  }
})

watch([rows, selected, confirmedIds, message, pageIndex], pokeQuery, { deep: true })

onMounted(() => {
  queryScope = systemScope(connection.value.easyOrigin, 'workflow')
  if (queryScope.endsWith('|local')) return
  void recallRecovery('limit-query', queryScope).then(payload => payload ?? recallRecovery('limit-query', 'workflow')).then(payload => {
    applyQueryDesk(payload)
  }).catch(() => { /* 没有账本就等下一次查询 */ })
})
onUnmounted(() => { void flushRecovery('limit-query', queryScope, readQueryDesk) })

function publish(): void {
  emit('result', {
    items: rows.value.slice(),
    gates: { ...gates.value },
    checking: loading.value || checkingGates.value,
    message: message.value
  })
}

function textFor(code: string, fallback: string, timeoutMs = 60_000): string {
  if (code === 'REQUEST_TIMEOUT') return `原网站查询太慢，没有在 ${timeoutMs / 60_000} 分钟内返回。可以把超时时间调长后再查。`
  if (code === 'SESSION_EXPIRED') return 'EASY 登录已失效，请在原网站重新登录后检测。'
  if (code === 'HTTP_ERROR') return 'EASY 暂时没有返回列表，可以再查一次。'
  if (code === 'INVALID_QUERY') return fallback || '请输入查询条件。'
  return fallback || '期限查询失败，请稍后重试。'
}

async function requestPage(query: LimitMonitorQuery): Promise<LimitMonitorResult> {
  if (!props.bridge || !props.connected) throw '尚未连接 EASY。'
  const timeoutMs = await readLimitTimeout()
  const response = await props.bridge.request({ type: MessageType.SearchLimitMonitor, payload: { query, timeoutMs } })
  if (response.type === MessageType.Error) throw response.payload.message
  if (response.type !== MessageType.SearchLimitMonitorResult) throw '期限查询返回了意外结果。'
  if (!response.payload.ok) throw textFor(response.payload.error.code, response.payload.error.message, timeoutMs)
  return response.payload.data
}

async function markSendGates(items: LimitMonitorRow[], merge = false): Promise<void> {
  const token = ++gateToken
  if (!props.bridge || !items.length) {
    if (!merge) {
      gates.value = {}
      checkingGates.value = false
    }
    return
  }
  const current = props.bridge
  checkingGates.value = true
  const jobs = new Map<string, { caseId: string; procId: string }>()
  for (const row of items) {
    if (isQueryGuid(row.caseId) && isQueryGuid(row.procId)) jobs.set(`${row.caseId}|${row.procId}`, { caseId: row.caseId, procId: row.procId })
  }
  const resolved = new Map<string, 'open' | 'pending' | 'done'>()
  const queue = [...jobs.values()]
  let failed = 0
  async function worker(): Promise<void> {
    while (queue.length && token === gateToken) {
      const job = queue.shift()
      if (!job) return
      const response = await current.request({ type: MessageType.ReadCaseBusFlow, payload: { caseId: job.caseId, procId: job.procId } })
      if (token !== gateToken) return
      if (response.type === MessageType.CaseBusFlowResult && response.payload.ok) {
        resolved.set(`${job.caseId}|${job.procId}`, response.payload.data.gate)
      } else {
        failed += 1
      }
    }
  }
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(4, Math.max(queue.length, 1)) }, () => worker()))
  if (token !== gateToken) return
  const next: Record<string, 'open' | 'pending' | 'done'> = {}
  let unchecked = 0
  for (const row of items) {
    if (!isQueryGuid(row.caseId) || !isQueryGuid(row.procId)) {
      unchecked += 1
      continue
    }
    const gate = resolved.get(`${row.caseId}|${row.procId}`)
    if (gate) next[row.procId] = gate
    else unchecked += 1
  }
  gates.value = merge ? { ...gates.value, ...next } : next
  checkingGates.value = false
  if (merge) {
    publish()
    return
  }
  selected.value = selected.value.filter(id => {
    const gate = next[id]
    return !gate || gate === 'open' || gate === 'done'
  })
  const pending = items.filter(row => next[row.procId] === 'pending').length
  const bits = [
    pending ? `待审核 ${pending} 个，已标灰，不能勾选。` : '',
    failed ? `${failed} 件没有读到发文流程，没有当成已提交审核。勾选还在，可以再点「提交到 EASY」。` : '',
    unchecked ? `${unchecked} 件没有核对到发文流程，不按还没提交审核计算。` : ''
  ].filter(Boolean)
  if (bits.length) message.value = [message.value, ...bits].filter(Boolean).join('')
  publish()
}

async function showCollected(query: Omit<LimitMonitorQuery, 'pageIndex' | 'pageSize'>): Promise<void> {
  loading.value = true
  sheetMerged.value = true
  selected.value = []
  message.value = '正在按这些文号一起查询…'
  publish()
  try {
    const first = await requestPage({ ...query, pageIndex: 1, pageSize: 100 })
    const items = [...first.items]
    const pages = Math.min(20, Math.ceil(first.total / 100))
    for (let page = 2; page <= pages; page += 1) {
      const next = await requestPage({ ...query, pageIndex: page, pageSize: 100 })
      items.push(...next.items)
    }
    rows.value = items
    gates.value = {}
    checkingGates.value = items.length > 0
    total.value = items.length
    pageIndex.value = 1
    message.value = items.length ? `一起查完，共 ${items.length} 件。` : '这个条件下没有期限记录。'
    publish()
    void markSendGates(items)
  } catch (error) {
    message.value = typeof error === 'string' ? error : '期限查询失败，请重试。'
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
    publish()
  }
}

async function queryEach(volumes: string[], ctrl: string): Promise<void> {
  loading.value = true
  sheetMerged.value = true
  selected.value = []
  const merged = new Map<string, LimitMonitorRow>()
  const missed: string[] = []
  try {
    for (let index = 0; index < volumes.length; index += 1) {
      const volume = volumes[index] ?? ''
      message.value = `正在逐个查询 ${index + 1}/${volumes.length}：${volume}`
      const fields = { case_volume: volume, ctrl_proc: ctrl }
      const data = await requestPage({ type: 'all', caseVolume: volume, ctrlProcId: ctrl, fields, pageIndex: 1, pageSize: 100 })
      if (!data.items.length) missed.push(volume)
      for (const row of data.items) merged.set(row.procId, row)
      rows.value = [...merged.values()]
      total.value = rows.value.length
      publish()
    }
    rows.value = [...merged.values()]
    gates.value = {}
    checkingGates.value = rows.value.length > 0
    total.value = rows.value.length
    pageIndex.value = 1
    lastQuery.value = { type: 'all', caseVolume: volumes[0] ?? '', ctrlProcId: ctrl, fields: { case_volume: volumes[0] ?? '', ctrl_proc: ctrl } }
    message.value = missed.length
      ? `逐个查完，共 ${rows.value.length} 件。这几个文号没有记录：${missed.slice(0, 8).join('、')}`
      : `逐个查完，共 ${rows.value.length} 件。`
    publish()
    void markSendGates(rows.value)
  } catch (error) {
    message.value = typeof error === 'string' ? error : '逐个查询中断了。'
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
    publish()
  }
}

async function search(input: SearchInput): Promise<void> {
  if (input.reset) {
    rows.value = []
    gates.value = {}
    checkingGates.value = false
    gateToken += 1
    total.value = 0
    message.value = ''
    pageIndex.value = 1
    selected.value = []
    templateId.value = ''
    lastQuery.value = null
    sheetMerged.value = false
    publish()
    return
  }
  if (!props.bridge || !props.connected) {
    message.value = '尚未连接 EASY。'
    publish()
    return
  }
  if (!isLimitMonitorType(input.type)) {
    message.value = '这个页签还不能查询。'
    publish()
    return
  }
  const query = {
    type: input.type,
    caseVolume: input.caseVolume ?? '',
    applicationNo: input.applicationNo ?? '',
    customerName: input.customerName ?? '',
    ...(input.ctrlProcId ? { ctrlProcId: input.ctrlProcId } : {}),
    ...(input.fields ? { fields: input.fields } : {})
  }
  lastQuery.value = query
  if (input.templateId) templateId.value = input.templateId
  if (!input.page) {
    confirmedIds.value = []
    emit('confirm', [])
  }
  if (!input.page && splitCaseVolumes(query.caseVolume ?? '').length > 1) {
    await showCollected(query)
    const volumes = splitCaseVolumes(query.caseVolume ?? '')
    if (!rows.value.length && volumes.length > 1 && query.ctrlProcId && !message.value.includes('登录')) await queryEach(volumes, query.ctrlProcId)
    return
  }
  if (!input.page) {
    selected.value = []
    sheetMerged.value = false
  }
  loading.value = true
  message.value = ''
  publish()
  const targetPage = input.page ?? 1
  try {
    const data = await requestPage({ ...query, pageIndex: targetPage, pageSize: pageSize.value })
    rows.value = data.items
    gates.value = {}
    checkingGates.value = data.items.length > 0
    total.value = data.total
    pageIndex.value = targetPage
    message.value = data.items.length ? '' : '这个条件下没有期限记录。'
    publish()
    void markSendGates(data.items)
  } catch (error) {
    message.value = typeof error === 'string' ? error : '期限查询失败，请重试。'
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
    publish()
  }
}

function goPage(page: number): void {
  if (sheetMerged.value) {
    const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rows.value.length / mergedPageSize))
    if (page < 1 || page > pages) return
    pageIndex.value = page
    return
  }
  if (!lastQuery.value || loading.value) return
  void search({ ...lastQuery.value, page })
}

function rowCanConfirm(procId: string): boolean {
  if (closedIds.value.has(procId.toLowerCase())) return false
  const flow = flowByProc.value[procId]
  if (flow === MAILED_UNFINISHED_REVIEW) return props.allowMailedUnfinished
  if (flow === '已提交审核' || flow === SKIP_SEND_REVIEW) return false
  const gate = gates.value[procId]
  if (gate === 'pending') return false
  return true
}

function blockMessage(ids: string[], verb: '提交' | '勾选'): string {
  if (checkingGates.value) {
    return verb === '提交' ? '还在核对发文审核状态，先不能提交。' : '还在核对发文审核状态，先不能确认。'
  }
  const reasons = ids.filter(id => isQueryGuid(id) && !rowCanConfirm(id)).map(id => {
    if (closedIds.value.has(id.toLowerCase())) return 'closed'
    const flow = flowByProc.value[id]
    if (flow === MAILED_UNFINISHED_REVIEW && !props.allowMailedUnfinished) return 'mailed'
    if (flow === SKIP_SEND_REVIEW) return 'skip'
    return 'review'
  })
  if (reasons.length && reasons.every(item => item === 'mailed')) {
    return verb === '提交'
      ? '已发文、事项还没写完成日的不能提交。上面的「已发文未管制的行允许发文」同时管勾选和提交，勾上之后再点提交，会先弹出警示框。'
      : '已发文、事项还没写完成日的不能勾选。先勾上上面的「已发文未管制的行允许发文」，这个开关同时管勾选和提交。'
  }
  if (reasons.length && reasons.every(item => item === 'skip')) {
    return verb === '提交' ? '不用发的不能提交。' : '不用发的不能勾选。'
  }
  if (reasons.length && reasons.every(item => item === 'closed')) return '这几件这次已经提交过，没有再提交。'
  return verb === '提交' ? '已提交审核的不能提交。' : '已提交审核的不能勾选。'
}

watch(() => props.allowMailedUnfinished, allow => {
  if (allow) return
  const next = selected.value.filter(id => flowByProc.value[id] !== MAILED_UNFINISHED_REVIEW)
  if (next.length !== selected.value.length) selected.value = next
})

function onConfirm(ids: string[]): void {
  const procIds = ids.filter(item => isQueryGuid(item) && rowCanConfirm(item))
  if (!procIds.length && ids.length) {
    message.value = blockMessage(ids, '勾选')
    return
  }
  confirmedIds.value = procIds
  const stored = readWorkflowTask()
  if (stored) writeWorkflowTask(clonePctTask({ ...stored, confirmedProcIds: procIds }))
  message.value = `已确认勾选 ${procIds.length} 件。再点「提交到 EASY」会创建发文并交给发文映射的默认审核人。`
  emit('confirm', procIds)
}

/** 进度浮窗标题带上这次提交用的模式，方便区分是哪种口径发出去的。 */
function submitTitle(address?: string): string {
  if (address === 'all') return '提交到 EASY：不信任仲裁全选'
  if (address === 'trust') return '提交到 EASY：信任仲裁'
  return '提交到 EASY：直接提交'
}

async function onSubmitAsk(address?: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!isWriteSwitchReady()) {
    message.value = '正在读取系统设置里的写开关。'
    return
  }
  if (!isWriteSwitchOpen()) {
    message.value = '写开关在系统设置里关着，没有提交到 EASY。'
    return
  }
  if (!props.bridge || !props.connected) {
    message.value = '尚未连接 EASY。'
    return
  }
  const bridge = props.bridge
  const task = readWorkflowTask()
  if (!selected.value.length) {
    message.value = '先勾选要提交的事项。'
    return
  }
  const live = selected.value.filter(item => isQueryGuid(item) && rowCanConfirm(item))
  if (!live.length) {
    message.value = blockMessage(selected.value, '提交')
    return
  }
  const procIds = live
  const mailedPending = rows.value.filter(row => procIds.includes(row.procId) && flowByProc.value[row.procId] === MAILED_UNFINISHED_REVIEW)
  if (mailedPending.length) {
    const goOn = await confirmDialog({
      title: `警示：${mailedPending.length} 行已发文、事项未管制完成日`,
      message: '这些行的发文流程已结束，但事项还没有管制完成日。\n这个状态分不出两种情况：真的发出过邮件，或没发文就把流程手动结束。请逐行确认到底发没发过，再提交会发一封新的：',
      table: {
        headers: ['文号', '事项', '客户'],
        rows: mailedPending.map(row => [row.caseVolume, row.ctrlProc, row.customerName])
      },
      confirmLabel: '核对过，继续提交',
      cancelLabel: '再核对',
      warn: true
    })
    if (!goOn) {
      message.value = '没有提交。已发文、事项未管制完成日的行要先核对。'
      return
    }
  }
  confirmedIds.value = procIds
  if (task) writeWorkflowTask(clonePctTask({ ...task, confirmedProcIds: procIds }))
  emit('confirm', procIds)
  const reviewerId = rules.value?.defaultReviewer?.userId ?? ''
  if (!isQueryGuid(reviewerId)) {
    message.value = '还没有默认审核人。请到发文映射里设置。'
    return
  }
  const planned = limitMailItems({
    reviewerId,
    procIds,
    rows: rows.value,
    sheetRows: props.sheetRows?.length ? props.sheetRows : (task?.rows ?? []),
    mode: props.recipientMode ?? (task?.recipientMode === 'lead' || task?.recipientMode === 'ipr' ? task.recipientMode : 'ipr'),
    specials: new Set(props.inventorCustomers ?? []),
    address: address === 'auto' || address === 'trust' ? 'auto' : address === 'all' ? 'all' : address === 'checked' ? 'checked' : 'named',
    ...(props.senderId && isQueryGuid(props.senderId) ? { senderId: props.senderId } : {})
  })
  if (!planned.ok) {
    message.value = planned.message
    return
  }
  message.value = `正在创建发文并提交给默认审核人${rules.value?.defaultReviewer?.name ?? ''}。`
  const involved = rows.value.filter(row => planned.items.some(item => limitMailProcIds(item).includes(row.procId)))
  beginProgress(submitTitle(address), planned.items.length + 1)
  const abnormal: Array<{ caseVolume: string; procLabel: string }> = []
  const sent = new Set<string>()
  const width = concurrency.value
  let handedOff = false
  const summaryRows: string[][] = []
  const cautionRows: string[][] = []
  try {
    if (width > 1 && involved.length) await markSendGates(involved, true)
    let finished = 0
    const { halted, unstarted } = await runMailLetterPool(planned.items, width, async (item) => {
      const letterRows = involved.filter(entry => limitMailProcIds(item).includes(entry.procId))
      const label = limitMailLetterLabel(item, id => letterRows.find(entry => entry.procId === id)?.caseVolume ?? '')
      logProgress(`正在核对 ${label} 的发文流程。`)
      if (width <= 1 && letterRows.length) await markSendGates(letterRows, true)
      logProgress(`正在处理 ${label}。`)
      const got: LimitMailSubmitResult[] = []
      const text = await runLimitMailSubmit(bridge, props.userId, [item], gates.value, result => got.push(result))
      const kind = classifySubmitText(text)
      tallyProgress(kind, limitMailProcIds(item).length)
      if (kind !== 'success') noteProgress(kind, label, text)
      if (kind === 'abnormal') {
        for (const row of letterRows) abnormal.push({ caseVolume: row.caseVolume, procLabel: row.ctrlProc })
      }
      const volumes = new Map(letterRows.map(row => [row.procId, row.caseVolume]))
      for (const result of got) {
        summaryRows.push([
          volumes.get(result.procId) ?? result.procId,
          clipCompany(item.customerName),
          result.to || '',
          result.cc || ''
        ])
        if (result.to && /请认真核对/.test(result.message)) cautionRows.push([volumes.get(result.procId) ?? result.procId, result.to])
      }
      finished += 1
      text.split('\n').forEach((line, lineIndex) => logProgress(lineIndex === 0 ? `${label}：${line}` : line, finished))
      if (kind === 'success') {
        for (const id of limitMailProcIds(item)) sent.add(id.toLowerCase())
      }
      return limitMailSubmitShouldHalt(text)
    })
    if (sent.size) {
      const keep = (id: string) => !sent.has(id.toLowerCase())
      confirmedIds.value = confirmedIds.value.filter(keep)
      selected.value = selected.value.filter(keep)
      const nextClosed = new Set(closedIds.value)
      for (const id of sent) nextClosed.add(id)
      closedIds.value = nextClosed
    }
    if (halted) {
      for (const item of unstarted) {
        const skipLabel = limitMailLetterLabel(item, id => rows.value.find(entry => entry.procId === id)?.caseVolume ?? '')
        const reason = '上一封结果无法确认，这一件没有开始。'
        tallyProgress('skipped', limitMailProcIds(item).length)
        noteProgress('skipped', skipLabel, reason)
        logProgress(`${skipLabel}：跳过。${reason}`)
      }
    }
    emit('confirm', confirmedIds.value)
    logProgress('正在回传所涉及案件的审核状态。', planned.items.length)
    await markSendGates(involved, true)
    emit('refreshStatus', {
      targets: involved.map(row => ({ caseVolume: row.caseVolume, procLabel: row.ctrlProc })),
      abnormal
    })
    handedOff = true
    message.value = ''
    publish()
    if (cautionRows.length) await warnBusinessRecipients(cautionRows)
    if (summaryRows.length) {
      const counts = progressSummaryLine().replace(/^统计：|。$/g, '')
      openSummary(
        `${submitTitle(address)} · ${counts}`,
        ['案号', '公司', '收件人', '抄送人'],
        summaryRows,
        `提交总结-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '')}.xlsx`
      )
    }
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    logProgress(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '提交中断了。')
    message.value = '提交中断了。进度框里有已经完成的统计。'
  } finally {
    if (!handedOff) {
      logProgress(progressSummaryLine())
      endProgress()
    }
  }
}

function volumeChunks(text: string): string[] {
  const volumes = splitCaseVolumes(text)
  const chunks: string[] = []
  let current: string[] = []
  let length = 0
  for (const volume of volumes) {
    const next = length + volume.length + (current.length ? 1 : 0)
    if (current.length >= 40 || (current.length && next > 1800)) {
      chunks.push(current.join(';'))
      current = [volume]
      length = volume.length
    } else {
      current.push(volume)
      length = next
    }
  }
  if (current.length) chunks.push(current.join(';'))
  return chunks
}

let procSearchToken = 0

async function searchProcGroups(groups: Array<{ id: string; volumes: string }>): Promise<void> {
  const token = ++procSearchToken
  loading.value = true
  sheetMerged.value = true
  selected.value = []
  confirmedIds.value = []
  emit('confirm', [])
  rows.value = []
  gates.value = {}
  total.value = 0
  pageIndex.value = 1
  const merged = new Map<string, LimitMonitorRow>()
  let failed = 0
  let clipped = 0
  let lastError = ''
  publish()
  try {
    const procIds = [...new Set(groups.map(group => group.id))]
    const lists = volumeChunks(groups.flatMap(group => splitCaseVolumes(group.volumes)).join(';'))
    for (let chunkIndex = 0; chunkIndex < lists.length; chunkIndex += 1) {
      if (token !== procSearchToken) return
      const volume = lists[chunkIndex] ?? ''
      const sheetCount = props.sheetRows?.length ?? 0
      message.value = `正在查 ${procIds.length} 种处理事项，文号第 ${chunkIndex + 1}/${lists.length} 段。已经对上 ${rows.value.length} 件${sheetCount ? `，表格一共 ${sheetCount} 行` : ''}。`
      publish()
      const fields: Record<string, string> = { ctrl_proc: procIds.join(','), case_volume: volume }
      const query = { type: 'all' as const, caseVolume: volume, ctrlProcId: procIds.join(','), fields, pageIndex: 1, pageSize: 100 }
        let items: LimitMonitorRow[] | null = null
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2 && !items; attempt += 1) {
          try {
            const first = await requestPage(query)
            const pageItems = [...first.items]
            const wanted = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(first.total / 100))
            const pages = Math.min(8, wanted)
            if (wanted > pages) clipped += 1
            for (let page = 2; page <= pages; page += 1) {
              if (token !== procSearchToken) return
              const next = await requestPage({ ...query, pageIndex: page })
              pageItems.push(...next.items)
            }
            items = pageItems
          } catch (error) {
            const text = typeof error === 'string' ? error : '期限查询失败，请重试。'
            if (/登录/.test(text)) throw text
            lastError = text
            if (attempt === 1) {
              failed += 1
              items = []
            }
          }
        }
      if (token !== procSearchToken) return
      const fresh: LimitMonitorRow[] = []
      for (const row of items ?? []) {
        if (merged.has(row.procId)) continue
        merged.set(row.procId, row)
        fresh.push(row)
      }
      if (fresh.length) rows.value.push(...fresh)
      total.value = rows.value.length
      publish()
    }
    if (token !== procSearchToken) return
    checkingGates.value = false
    lastQuery.value = null
    const sheetCount = props.sheetRows?.length ?? 0
    const missedNote = failed ? `${failed} 段没查成。` : ''
    const clipNote = clipped ? `${clipped} 段只取了前 800 件。` : ''
    message.value = rows.value.length
      ? (sheetCount
          ? `上面 ${rows.value.length} 件是这些文号在期限监控里还没办完的处理事项，没有按官方期限筛。下面表格一共 ${sheetCount} 行。${missedNote}${clipNote}`
          : `期限里还没结束的一共 ${rows.value.length} 件。${missedNote}${clipNote}`)
      : (lastError || '这个条件下没有期限记录。')
    publish()
    if (!props.flowChecking && rows.value.length && rows.value.length <= 80) void markSendGates(rows.value)
  } catch (error) {
    if (token !== procSearchToken) return
    message.value = typeof error === 'string' ? error : '期限查询失败，请重试。'
  } finally {
    if (token === procSearchToken) {
      loading.value = false
      publish()
    }
  }
}

function clearProcQuery(): void {
  procSearchToken += 1
  gateToken += 1
  loading.value = false
  rows.value = []
  gates.value = {}
  checkingGates.value = false
  total.value = 0
  pageIndex.value = 1
  selected.value = []
  confirmedIds.value = []
  sheetMerged.value = false
  message.value = ''
  publish()
}

watch(() => props.seedToken, () => {
  const groups = (props.procQueries ?? []).filter(item => isQueryGuid(item.id) && splitCaseVolumes(item.volumes).length > 0)
  if (groups.length) {
    void searchProcGroups(groups)
    return
  }
  const seed = props.seed
  if (!seed || !props.seedToken) {
    if (props.seedToken) clearProcQuery()
    return
  }
  const volume = props.caseVolume || seed.case_volume || ''
  const ctrl = seed.ctrl_proc ?? ''
  const fields = { ...seed }
  if (volume.length > 4000) delete fields.case_volume
  else if (volume) fields.case_volume = volume
  void search({
    type: 'all',
    caseVolume: volume,
    applicationNo: seed.app_no ?? '',
    customerName: seed.customer_name ?? '',
    ...(ctrl ? { ctrlProcId: ctrl } : {}),
    fields
  })
}, { immediate: true, flush: 'post' })
</script>

<template>
  <LimitPage
    embedded
    live
    hide-form
    selectable
    :selected="selected"
    :rows="sheetMerged ? rows : pagedRows"
    :cache-pages="sheetMerged"
    :plain-proc-ids="plainProcIds"
    :flow-by-proc="flowByProc"
    :gates="gates"
    :checking="checkingGates || Boolean(flowChecking)"
    :total="sheetMerged ? rows.length : total"
    :loading="loading"
    :message="message"
    :connected="connected"
    :page-index="pageIndex"
    :page-size="sheetMerged ? mergedPageSize : pageSize"
    :page-while-loading="sheetMerged"
    :writes-open="writesOpen"
    :writes-ready="writesReady"
    :ipr-gap="hasIprGap"
    :allow-mailed-unfinished="allowMailedUnfinished"
    @page="goPage"
    @select="selected = $event"
    @confirm="onConfirm"
    @submit="onSubmitAsk"
  >
    <LimitQuerySection
      :bridge="bridge"
      :user-id="userId"
      :can-search="connected && !loading"
      :seed="seed"
      :seed-token="seedToken"
      @search="search"
    />
  </LimitPage>
</template>

const arbitrateIprOnly = ref(false)

const carryAcrossBreaks = ref(false)

    { key: 'submitted', label: '已提交审核', count: submitted, color: '#9a6700' },

function rowsOnSheetPage(page: number): PctTaskRow[] {

  return rows.value.slice(start, start + SHEET_PAGE_SIZE)

function resetSheetPages(): void {

const sheetHost = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)
const sheetColWidths = ref<number[]>([])
const sheetTableStyle = computed(() => {
  const total = sheetColWidths.value.reduce((sum, width) => sum + width, 0)
  if (!total) return undefined
  return { width: `${total}px`, minWidth: '100%' }
})
let sheetRuler: HTMLSpanElement | null = null
let sheetObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null
let sheetObserved: HTMLElement | null = null

function sheetTextWidth(text: string, source: Element): number {
  if (!sheetRuler) return 0
  sheetRuler.style.font = getComputedStyle(source).font
  sheetRuler.textContent = text
  return Math.ceil(sheetRuler.offsetWidth) + 2
}

function layoutSheet(): void {
  const root = sheetHost.value
  if (!root || !sheetRuler) return
  if (sheetObserved !== root) {
    if (sheetObserved) sheetObserver?.unobserve(sheetObserved)
    sheetObserver?.observe(root)
    sheetObserved = root
  }
  const pageRows = rowsOnSheetPage(sheetPageSafe.value)
  if (!pageRows.length) {
    sheetColWidths.value = []
    return
  }
  const container = root.clientWidth
  if (container <= 0) return
  const table = root.querySelector('table')
  if (!table) return
  const header = table.querySelector('thead th') || table
  const cell = table.querySelector('tbody td') || header
  const pad = 16
  const minOf = (title: string) => sheetTextWidth(title, header) + pad
  const widest = (title: string, values: string[]) => {
    let content = minOf(title)
    for (const value of values) content = Math.max(content, sheetTextWidth(value, cell) + pad)
    return { min: minOf(title), content }
  }
  const volume = widest('我方文号', pageRows.map(row => row.ourVolume))
  const customer = widest('客户', pageRows.map(row => row.customerName || '表格里没有'))
  const customerVolume = widest('客户文号', pageRows.map(row => row.customerVolume || '无'))
  const proc = widest('处理事项', pageRows.map(row => row.procLabel))
  const typeMin = minOf('发文类型')
  let typeContent = typeMin
  for (const row of pageRows) {
    const label = row.mailTypeId ? (row.mailTypeLabel || '') : '选择发文类型'
    let width = sheetTextWidth(label, row.mailTypeId ? cell : header) + pad
    if (!row.mailTypeId) width += 22
    typeContent = Math.max(typeContent, width)
  }
  const to = widest('收件人', pageRows.flatMap(row => [shownTo(row), carriedContactNote(row)].filter(Boolean)))
  const cc = widest('抄送', pageRows.map(row => shownCc(row)))
  const found = widest('查询结果', pageRows.map(row => sheetStatus(row).found))
  const review = widest('审核状态', pageRows.map(row => sheetStatus(row).review))
  sheetColWidths.value = assignColumnWidths([
    volume,
    { ...customer, grow: true },
    customerVolume,
    proc,
    { min: typeMin, content: typeContent },
    { ...to, grow: true },
    cc,
    found,
    { ...review, lock: true }
  ], container)
}

async function onSheet(event: Event): Promise<void> {
  const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement
  const file = input.files?.[0]
  input.value = ''
  previews.value = []
  cards.value = []
  progress.value = []
  status.value = ''
  abnormalKeys.value = new Set()
  arbitrationBoard.value = []
  arbitrationOpen.value = false
  resetLimit()
  if (!file) return
  sheetName.value = file.name
  if (!file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.xlsx')) {
  rows.value = []
  gapWaves.value = []
  sheetNotice.value = '请传入表格文件。'
    return
  }
  const generation = ++sheetImportToken
  sheetNotice.value = '正在读取表格…'
  try {
    await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 0))
    if (generation !== sheetImportToken) return
    const parsed = pctRowsFromWorkbook(await readXlsxSheets(await file.arrayBuffer(), isPctWorkbookSheet), props.mailTypes, runtime.value, carryAcrossBreaks.value ? 'cross' : 'block')
    if (generation !== sheetImportToken) return
    rows.value = applyPctMailTypes(parsed.rows, props.mailTypes, runtime.value)
    resetSheetPages()
    gapWaves.value = iprArbitrationWaves(rowsForArbitration(), {}, {}, { iprOnly: arbitrateIprOnly.value })
    sheetNotice.value = parsed.notice
    await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 0))
    if (generation !== sheetImportToken) return
    buildPreview()
    void startSheetQuery()
  } catch (error) {
    rows.value = []
    gapWaves.value = []
    sheetNotice.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : '表格没有读出来。'
  }
}

  const next = rows.value.map(row => {

    return applyPctMailTypes([row], props.mailTypes, runtime.value)[0] ?? row
  })
  if (next.every((row, index) => row.mailTypeId === rows.value[index]?.mailTypeId)) return
  rows.value = next
  buildPreview()
})
